description: Stairville SonicPulse LED Bar 10 (8 RGBW segments of 3 LEDs). The Bar 05 is the same with 4 segments: its 4, 5, 6 and 11CH modes are these, its 23CH mode is the 7 header channels and 4 RGBW segments. Modes: 4CH, 5CH, 6CH, 11CH, 39CH; 39CH is the default. Generated from the Open Fixture Library (MIT licence, stairville/sonicpulse-led-bar-10 at commit d9d675e) and checked against the manual.

modes.name: 5CH
modes.description: Dimmer (follows the brightness), Auto Mode (off), Effect Selection (off), Sound Mode Selection (off), Sound Sensitivity (off). No colour mixing in this mode: only the brightness follows PitchControl.

modes.name: 6CH
modes.description: Dimmer (held at full), Shutter / Strobe, RGBW.

modes.name: 11CH
modes.description: Dimmer (held at full), Shutter / Strobe, Mode Selection (off), Color Presets (off), Effect Selection (off), Sound Mode Selection (off), Auto Mode Speed (off), RGBW.

modes.name: 39CH
modes.description: Dimmer (held at full), Shutter / Strobe, Mode Selection (off), Color Presets (off), Effect Selection (off), Sound Mode Selection (off), Auto Mode Speed (off), 8 × RGBW.
